final_message:
**Status: verified** at full precision (`local-full`). The function is a pointer lookup, implemented by `mlp0`, head `1.2` and `mlp1`; the other five heads are inert.

## The algorithm

Token ids: 0 BOS, 2 fu, 3 ko, 4 la, 5 nu, 6 vo.

```
last = tokens[6]
j    = 2 if last in (fu, ko) else 1     # mlp0 at the last position: last token -> pointer
b    = tokens[j]                        # head 1.2: last position attends to position j
out  = G[last][b]                       # mlp1 at the last position: table lookup
```

Positions 3, 4 and 5 are never used. The table `G` (rows = last token, columns = selected token):

| last \ selected | fu | ko | la | nu | vo |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **fu** | ko | nu | vo | vo | ko |
| **ko** | nu | ko | la | la | nu |
| **la** | nu | vo | vo | vo | nu |
| **nu** | nu | la | fu | la | ko |
| **vo** | nu | vo | la | vo | nu |

## Circuit

- **`mlp0` (last position):** turns the last token into the pointer. Patching it restores 100% of the metric when the two last tokens are in different pointer classes and 0% when they are in the same class (E0016, E0017), so it carries the pointer and nothing else that matters.
- **Head `1.2`:** attention from the last position is 1.00 on position 1 for la/nu/vo and 1.00 on position 2 for fu/ko (E0007, E0008).
- **`mlp1` (last position):** does the lookup. Mean-ablating it alone leaves −0.7% of the metric (E0011).
- **Inert:** heads `0.0`, `0.1`, `0.2`, `1.0`, `1.1`. Ablating all five together leaves 100% (E0013).

## Verification (V0001, 400 held-out inputs, seed 7)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `predict()` agrees with the model | 100%, no disagreements |
| Circuit ablated | 0.4% of the clean metric, accuracy 35% |
| Everything else ablated | 100% of the metric, accuracy 100% |
| Random same-size ablations | 100%, 100%, 100% |
| Null controls | all three passed, each at the 100th percentile |

## Prediction record

Nine of ten pre-registered predictions held. The miss was E0010: I predicted that everything outside `1.2` and `mlp1` was irrelevant, but ablating it left only 64%. Follow-ups traced the whole loss to `mlp0` (E0012), which the gradient screen had scored at zero, and the circuit was revised to include it.

## What was not measured

- **Query vs key:** that the pointer enters `1.2` through its query is inferred, not measured. The path-patching call with `mlp0` as sender failed with a tool error.
- **Last-token identity into `mlp1`:** that it comes straight from the embedding is by elimination (not `mlp0`, not the other heads).
- **Table coverage:** `G` was read off 100 examples and checked on 400 random held-out inputs, not on all 15,625.
- **Structure in `G`:** I found none beyond a lookup table, and did not test whether it factors into simpler maps.

## Budget and report

17 of 25 experiments used, plus one verification. Two further calls errored (the path-patching one above and a mis-typed positions argument) and were not charged.

The report is in `benchmarks\glassbox-bench\seed-3\runs\t4\report\` under the working directory, as `report.md` and `report.html`.
